purpose: Candidate metadata snapshots and read-only lifecycle inspection; not runtime approval or a transitive dependency audit.

scripts.prepare: node -e "if (!process.env.AUTHORIZED) { console.error('ERROR: Direct publishing is not allowed.\nPlease see the release workflow documentation to publish this package.'); process.exit(1); }"

audit.optional_dependencies: Eight native packages, all exact version 2.1.302; root dependencies empty.
audit.writes: Only package-local bin/claude.exe: link, copy, unlink, chmod and placeholder restoration; no directory creation or HOME/npmrc writes.
audit.execution: No network or native binary execution. Darwin x64 runs PATH sysctl without a timeout; the mandatory native-arm64 Node gate excludes that branch on supported macOS.
audit.failure: Native absence may exit zero leaving a 500-byte placeholder. Placement is not atomic; install or later failure may leave a modified prefix and requires uninstall before retry.
audit.closure: Expected root plus one native, only root postinstall runs. Both tarballs must verify before offline installation using an empty private cache; sealed acceptance must prove the optional dependency uses that single native copy.
audit.prepare: Publishing guard; not expected to run for tarball installation. If invoked without AUTHORIZED it exits 1, failing closed.
audit.verification: Read-only tarball/member inspection only; no installer, provider binary or lifecycle code executed. Native member is package/claude; installation target is root bin/claude.exe.

native_archive_listing.reference: Issue #131 2442/2482: SHA-512 verified before streaming member hashing, no installation or execution.
native_archive_listing.types: All four regular files; only program member is package/claude. No symlink, hardlink, extended header, device or additional program member.
native_archive_listing.format: Single gzip member, plain ustar; zero padding, two terminal zero blocks, no trailing content.
